name: Yuugiri ~Ningyoushi no Isan~
source:
Kyohei is a college student. During summer vacation he visits his hometown. At the train station he's stuck in the fierce rain and invited by a beautiful woman to take shelter in her house. There is a locked door in the house that emits blue light and has the note on it saying "Beware of the bell".

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-august-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
恭平是一名大學生，暑假期間回到故鄉。他在車站遭遇傾盆大雨，一名美女邀請他到自己家中避雨。屋裡有一扇上鎖的門，不斷散發藍光；門上還貼著一張紙條，上面寫著「當心鈴聲」。

［引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-august-1996.html]vndbreview[/url]］
